subject: Geopolitics
title: Undersea Cable Tapping
description: A quick win: understand Undersea Cable Tapping.

hook.text: 95% of international data flows through underwater cables. Tap one and you can read a continent's internet.

buildup.text: Submarine cables carry $10 trillion in daily financial transactions.

discovery.text: The US and UK tap cables at landing points. The GCHQ's Tempora program collected vast amounts of passing data.

twist.text: Russia has mapped every cable route and deployed submarines near them. The threat of severing them is real.

climax.text: Cable security is now a geopolitical issue. Nations are rerouting cables to avoid hostile waters and territories.

punchline.text: The internet's backbone lies on the ocean floor, unguarded.

quiz.question: What percentage of international data flows through undersea cables?
